ar-cold.iv_model: Explicit assumed power at an assumed 0.75 Voc operating point. Lux is metadata, never an input to a watts conversion. No source response outside these points.
ar-cold.model_scope: assumed port power, ideal capacitor, ideal atomic NVM, assumed regulator/load, deterministic digital receiver; no calibrated IV or hardware

service_semantics.gap: After reset report an unobserved interval bracketed by last durable observation and fresh synchronization, without claiming exact outage times.
service_semantics.history: Every durable record must survive a reset; sample retention and continuous new sampling have separate gates.
service_semantics.priority: Abnormal event records have priority over routine samples on capacity exhaustion; every eviction is counted and declared.
service_semantics.time: No powered RTC after brownout; records without synchronization have an interval and UNKNOWN absolute time.
service_semantics.upload: Oldest unacknowledged first, remove from pending only after ACK; receiver key=(device,sequence).

capacitance_f.source: ar.py validate: 0<C<=1; ideal one-capacitor model, not qualified component stock

off_v.source: ar.py validate lower threshold bound; output/dropout guard still applies

ready_v.source: ar.py validate: off<ready<cap_voltage_max; original maximum 3.3 V fixed

sample_period_s.source: 1 s integration; history task requires at most 60 s; no skipped-service waiver

ack_spacing_s.source: explicit program timing choice at 1 s resolution; all energy costs fixed

retry_s.source: explicit retry timing choice within 1 h public run; energy is debited for every attempt

rank.source: bounded executable numeric AST; BF/Pi supplies the expression; minimum score wins, stable sequence tie break
rank.clock_basis: age_s=max(0,local synchronized time-record timestamp) only when both are synchronized; otherwise 0 and age_known=0. No true created_s, future source, gateway schedule or evaluator fields.

fixed_parameters.source: all source segments, watts, IV assumptions, efficiency, horizons, gateway, temperature truth and service criteria are exact historical task inputs
fixed_parameters.initial_energy: zero capacitor voltage; no precharge, second source, powered timekeeper or extra human action
fixed_parameters.device: all keys except capacitance_f/off_v/ready_v are fixed; sample and ACK cadence are set only by the executable program
fixed_parameters.model_limits: ideal capacitor/NVM and nominal storage-side energy impulses, 1 s chronology; no calibrated hardware, regulator switching or RF model

program_change_scope: only rank and timing are new v2 execution hooks; wire encoding, energy debits, persistence, thresholds and public receiver remain v1 semantics
acceptance: Each service gate is independent and applicability explicit; retention/gaps never substitute for new sampling or absolute time. Participant submit is not acceptance. External checker reads immutable artifacts and saves a separate receipt.

parameter_provenance.scope: existing physical/digital behavior and validator domain
archived official documents; not measurements or component qualification

claim_boundary: Nominal public-development computation. Codex implements tools/checker and records assistance; BF/Pi must author actual D/program and reasoning after S0 lease. No H benefit, transfer, RSI or hardware claim.
